class multifit.input.ModelConfig(module, function: str, number_of_peaks: int, spectrum_params: list[str], peak_params: list[str], kwargs: dict)

Bases: object

Class for configuration of the model

The model consists of a cumulative density function describing a single peak structure. The function may be repeated to model several peak structures. Each function parameter may be shared by all peaks in a spectrum or all instances of a peak across spectra.

module

Path to the python module where the model function is defined.

Type:

Path

function

Name of the function defining the model.

Type:

str

number_of_peaks

Number of peak structures to model for each spectrum.

Type:

int

spectrum_params

Name of parameters to be shared by all peaks in a spectrum.

Type:

list[str]

peak_params

Name of parameters to be shared by all instances of the same peak across spectra.

Type:

list[str]

kwargs

Additional keyword arguments required by the function.

Type:

dict

multifit.input.fetch_data(config: DataConfig, cls, sorting_key=0, npy=True) → list[Spectrum | CoincidenceMatrix]

Read data files.

WARNING: This function will be depracated in the future.

Parameters:

  • config (DataConfig) – Data configuration object.

  • cls – Class to read the data into, possible values are Spectrum and CoincidenceMatrix.

  • sorting_key – key to use when sorting the data object list. May be a constant or a callable taking the file name as a positional argument.

  • npy (bool) – If true, try to read the data from a .npy file. If such a file doesn’t exist, generate it. (default True)

Returns:

Sorted list of data objects read from each file.

Return type:

list[Spectrum | CoincidenceMatrix]
